mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 6-month moving average signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST relative to 6-month average is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or positive 20-day returns occur in less than 40% of high HOUST periods.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.25% signals monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 30% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (INDPRO above 12-month average), economic overheating leads to policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 12-month average, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) signals the Federal Reserve may tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%), lower discount rates boost equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market, which drives economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity, which signals economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO level fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 30% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).
